statement: A token is never issued from an earlier token on a revocation read that failed: a refresh, or a tenant switch, whose revocations cannot be read (RevocationUnavailableException) fails, never reads the earlier token as not revoked, so a revoked token, or a token of a revoked principal, cannot be refreshed or switched into one that no revocation names. The pipeline's degraded verification (PIP-7), which whoever builds the token authenticator states explicitly, applies to verifying a token only.
guards: jwt:RefreshTokenAuthenticationTest#a refresh is refused when the revocations cannot be read
login:SwitchLiveSessionTest#a switch whose revocations cannot be read issues nothing
